background: Metro Bank is a UK high-street challenger bank founded on a branch-led model, funded by retail and business deposits and lending on mortgages, commercial property and to smaller companies, recapitalised and controlled by a Colombian investor after its capital crisis.
synthesis: Fitch is the only agency rating the bank, at BB with a positive outlook after its upgrade on 12 Aug 2026, below investment grade but moving up. Capital is mixed against UK mid-sized banks: CET1 of 12.3% is in the bottom quarter while leverage of 7.4% is at the peer median. Liquidity is the strength, with LCR of 288% and NSFR of 159% both in the top quarter. Since 30 Jun 2024 leverage has risen 1.9 points and NSFR 12 points while CET1 has fallen 0.6 points and LCR 31 points; the upgrade is the only flagged news.
